content: Kunal Mehta called insurance agent Anita Sharma to check the status of his home policy, which is currently pending due to a missing signed declaration and valuation report. Kunal confirmed he will email the documents tomorrow morning as a single PDF under 5 MB, and will pay the $850 premium via bank transfer today. Anita agreed to resend the bank details and a checklist via email and stated the policy will be activated within a few hours of document verification.

action_items: Kunal to email the signed declaration and valuation report as a single PDF tomorrow morning
Kunal to complete the $850 bank transfer today
Anita to email the bank details and checklist after the call
